strategies.test-case: Project + suite/file + failed or newly written/edited test identity.
strategies.stack-site: Exception type + owned throw-site frame parsed from failed runtime output.
strategies.config-change: Confirmed config filename + parsed complete key path + before/after change.
strategies.dependency-change: Package ecosystem + package name from manifest writes/edits; old versions stay unknown when absent.

strategy_interface: function(unit) -> matches with group_key, event_position, evidence_line
event_filtering: strategy-owned; each function receives all projected events including tool arguments
session_overlap: deduplicate expanded segments by original event index/part/channel
error_strategy_excluded: tool call arguments as error evidence
output_missing_policy: report missing payload; never infer a tool error from its metadata
semantic_limits: same group key does not prove same Skill
nearby events do not prove a causal chain
text mention is not an observed outcome
